## Ops: AI Gateway
Every AI call goes through here: versioned prompt, daily budget breaker, timeout + retries, cost logging, output validation.

**Input:** automationId, promptName, promptVersion (optional), vars, maxTokens (optional), effort (optional).
**Output:** ok, retryable, outcome, error, value, usage, costUsd, promptVersion, latencyMs.
Call it with an Execute Workflow node set to 'Run once for each item'.

parameters.query:
SELECT a.id AS automation_id,
       p.output_schema,
       a.daily_budget_usd::float AS budget,
       (SELECT coalesce(sum(cost_usd), 0) FROM ai_calls
         WHERE automation_id = a.id AND created_at >= current_date)::float AS spent_today,
       p.version, p.system_prompt, p.user_template
FROM automations a
LEFT JOIN prompts p
  ON p.automation_id = a.id
 AND p.name = $2::text
 AND p.version = COALESCE(NULLIF($3::text, ''),
       (SELECT version FROM prompts WHERE automation_id = $1::text AND name = $2::text AND active))
WHERE a.id = $1::text;

INSERT INTO ai_calls (automation_id, prompt_version, model, outcome, input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_usd, latency_ms, error)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9);
